good.subject: auth: add JWT token refresh with sliding expiration window
good.description:
Access tokens now refresh automatically when the remaining TTL drops below
30 seconds. This prevents mid-session logouts for users on slow connections
without requiring a full re-authentication round-trip.

good.subject: fix: resolve race condition in concurrent request handler
good.description:
Two goroutines could simultaneously write to the response buffer when the
upstream took longer than the client timeout. Added a mutex guard around
the write path and added a regression test that reproduces the original race.

good.subject: docs: update installation instructions for Python 3.12
good.description:
Python 3.11 reached end-of-life. Updated the quickstart section to target
3.12, removed the outdated virtualenv step, and added the uv-based workflow
that matches the project's current tooling.

good.subject: parser: extract commit parsing logic into dedicated module
good.description:
The parser was embedded inside the CLI entrypoint, making it untestable in
isolation. Moving it to parser.py allows unit tests to cover edge cases
such as empty bodies, binary content, and malformed trailer blocks.

good.subject: fix: prevent duplicate inserts under high concurrency using advisory locks
good.description:
Under load tests we observed duplicate rows when two workers raced on the
same idempotency key. Switching to advisory locks in the INSERT path removes
the window entirely without adding a separate SELECT before every write.

good.subject: perf: reduce memory usage by 40% via streaming file reads
good.description:
The indexer previously loaded entire files into memory before parsing.
Replacing the bulk read with a line-by-line generator cuts peak RSS from
~800 MB to ~480 MB on the largest corpus in the benchmark suite.

good.subject: cli: add --output-format flag supporting json, csv, and text
good.description:
CI pipelines downstream of this tool need machine-readable output.
Adding --output-format avoids ad-hoc grep parsing of human text and
makes the json and csv paths available without a separate formatter script.

good.subject: fix: correct token expiry calculation for non-UTC timezones
good.description:
datetime.now() returned local time while expiry was stored as UTC epoch.
The delta was negative for timezones behind UTC, causing every token to
appear expired immediately. All datetime arithmetic now uses timezone-aware
objects anchored to UTC.

good.subject: chore: bump pyyaml from 6.0.1 to 6.0.2 to address CVE-2024-1234
good.description:
CVE-2024-1234 allows arbitrary code execution when loading untrusted YAML
with the default Loader. Upgrading to 6.0.2 patches the vulnerability.
No API changes required; all existing tests pass.

good.subject: search: implement full-text search using trigram indexes
good.description:
LIKE queries on the notes table caused sequential scans above ~100k rows.
Adding a GIN trigram index and rewriting the query to use @@ ts_query
brings p99 latency from 4.2s down to 38ms on the production dataset.

good.subject: fix: handle empty commit body without raising IndexError
good.description:
git log --format with %b outputs an empty string for commits that have
no body. The splitter assumed at least one line was always present.
Added an early-return guard and a test covering the empty-body case.

good.subject: cache: add Redis-backed session cache with configurable TTL
good.description:
The in-process dict cache did not survive worker restarts and caused
users to be logged out on every deploy. Redis persistence keeps sessions
alive across deploys; TTL is read from SESSION_CACHE_TTL_SECONDS env var.

good.subject: fix: enforce 50 MB file size limit before writing to disk
good.description:
Large uploads were streamed to disk before the size check ran, wasting
I/O and disk quota. The limit is now enforced by reading Content-Length
upfront and rejecting the request before any data is written.

good.subject: perf: add composite index on (user_id, created_at) for timeline
good.description:
Timeline queries filter on user_id and sort by created_at. The separate
single-column indexes caused the planner to pick a full sort on a large
heap fetch. The composite index drops the query from 900ms to under 5ms.

good.subject: notifications: send weekly email digest of activity summaries
good.description:
Users asked for a way to catch up after periods of inactivity without
logging in daily. The weekly digest aggregates unread events and sends
a single email every Monday at 08:00 UTC via the existing mailer job.

good.subject: fix: preserve timezone info when serializing datetime fields
good.description:
The JSON serializer called .isoformat() on naive datetimes, dropping
timezone context. Downstream consumers silently interpreted times as local
zone, causing off-by-hours bugs in multi-region deployments.

good.subject: router: split monolithic router into feature-scoped sub-routers
good.description:
The single router.py file grew to 1400 lines with mixed concerns.
Each feature area (auth, billing, admin) now registers its own APIRouter
and is included in the main app with a prefix, improving discoverability.

good.subject: pagination: replace offset-based with cursor-based pagination
good.description:
Offset pagination produces inconsistent pages when records are inserted
or deleted between requests. Cursors based on (created_at, id) are stable
and also avoid the costly COUNT(*) that blocked on large tables.

good.subject: fix: retry failed deliveries with exponential backoff
good.description:
Failed webhook deliveries were dropped silently. Retries now follow a
2^n * 100ms schedule up to 5 attempts, after which the delivery is marked
dead and the operator is notified via the existing alerting channel.

good.subject: audit: log all admin actions to append-only audit table
good.description:
Compliance requires a tamper-evident record of privilege operations.
Admin actions now write a signed entry to audit_log before executing.
The table uses row-level security so only the audit reader role can SELECT.

good.subject: refactor: inject dependencies via constructor instead of globals
good.description:
Module-level singletons made unit testing require monkeypatching sys.modules.
Constructor injection makes dependencies explicit, allows fakes in tests,
and eliminates import-order-dependent initialisation bugs.

good.subject: rbac: introduce role-based access control for API endpoints
good.description:
All endpoints previously shared the same authentication check with no
authorisation layer. RBAC adds viewer/editor/admin roles enforced at the
decorator level; existing sessions are migrated to the editor role.

good.subject: fix: prevent overlapping job runs with a distributed lock
good.description:
On multi-instance deployments all workers fired the nightly cleanup job
simultaneously, causing duplicate side-effects and thundering-herd on the
database. A Redis SETNX lock ensures only one instance runs the job.

good.subject: metrics: expose Prometheus counters for request rates and errors
good.description:
The SRE team needs per-endpoint error rates to set SLO burn-rate alerts.
Added http_requests_total and http_errors_total counters with method,
path, and status_code labels, scraped at /metrics without auth.

good.subject: fix: skip blank lines instead of treating them as data rows
good.description:
Exported CSVs from Excel include a trailing newline that was parsed as
an empty data row, causing a validation error on the last line of every
file. Added a pre-filter that drops rows where all fields are empty.

good.subject: graphql: add cursor-based connection type for paginated lists
good.description:
The flat list type forced clients to implement their own pagination state.
The Relay-compatible Connection type exposes edges, pageInfo, and cursors
and is backward-compatible because the old list field still resolves.

good.subject: fix: regenerate session ID after privilege escalation
good.description:
Failing to rotate the session ID after privilege escalation leaves the
application vulnerable to session fixation (OWASP A07). The session is
now invalidated and a new one issued immediately after sudo-mode is granted.

good.subject: perf: lazy-load images below the fold to improve LCP
good.description:
Lighthouse flagged 14 off-screen images being loaded eagerly on the
dashboard page. Adding loading=lazy to images outside the initial viewport
reduces total blocking time by 620ms and improves LCP from 4.1s to 1.9s.

good.subject: workspace: allow users to create and switch between workspaces
good.description:
Enterprise accounts requested project isolation without separate logins.
Workspaces provide a namespace boundary for resources and settings while
sharing a single authentication identity across all workspaces.

good.subject: fix: increase HTTP client read timeout to 30s for slow upstreams
good.description:
The report-generation endpoint calls an upstream that can take up to 25s
under heavy load. The 10s default timeout caused intermittent 504 errors
on valid requests. Timeout is now configurable per upstream in config.yml.

good.subject: ci: add matrix build for Python 3.11, 3.12, and 3.13
good.description:
The project claims compatibility with all three minor versions but only
3.11 was tested in CI. Adding a matrix job catches incompatibilities before
they reach users, particularly around typing and match-statement syntax.

good.subject: 2fa: add TOTP-based two-factor authentication with recovery codes
good.description:
Security audit identified missing MFA as a high-severity finding.
TOTP follows RFC 6238 with a 30-second window; ten single-use recovery
codes are generated at enrollment and stored as bcrypt hashes.

good.subject: fix: prevent SQL injection in dynamic ORDER BY clause
good.description:
The sort parameter was interpolated directly into the query string.
An allowlist of valid column names now validates the input before
it reaches the query builder, and a test covers the injection vector.

good.subject: batch: process large CSV imports via asynchronous background workers
good.description:
Importing files larger than ~5000 rows timed out the HTTP request.
The upload now stores the file and enqueues a Celery task; the client
polls a /jobs/{id}/status endpoint until the import completes.

good.subject: fix: restrict allowed origins to configured whitelist in production
good.description:
The wildcard CORS header was left over from local development and made
it into production, allowing any origin to make credentialed requests.
Origins are now read from ALLOWED_ORIGINS and validated at startup.

good.subject: perf: replace json.dumps with orjson for 3x throughput gain
good.description:
The API serialisation path appeared in every flame graph above 8% CPU.
orjson is a drop-in replacement that uses a Rust backend; benchmarks show
3.1x throughput improvement with identical output for all tested payloads.

good.subject: theming: support custom brand colours via CSS custom properties
good.description:
White-label customers asked to replace the default blue accent colour.
CSS custom properties (--color-primary, --color-accent) are now read from
the tenant config and injected as a <style> block in the document head.

good.subject: fix: trim whitespace from email before uniqueness check
good.description:
Users copying their email from a document sometimes include a trailing
space, causing a duplicate-user error even though the email is unique.
The email is now stripped before validation and before storage.

good.subject: rate-limit: apply per-user limit of 1000 requests per minute
good.description:
A handful of API consumers were generating bulk traffic that degraded
response times for all other users. The rate limiter uses a sliding window
counter in Redis; over-limit requests receive HTTP 429 with Retry-After.

good.subject: fix: prevent timing attack via constant-time token comparison
good.description:
String equality short-circuits on the first differing byte, leaking
partial token information through response timing. hmac.compare_digest
provides constant-time comparison regardless of where strings diverge.

good.subject: tasks: replace threading.Timer with APScheduler for recurring jobs
good.description:
threading.Timer does not survive exceptions and cannot be inspected or
cancelled from outside the spawning thread. APScheduler adds a persistent
job store, structured logging, and graceful shutdown on SIGTERM.

good.subject: dashboard: add real-time activity feed using Server-Sent Events
good.description:
Users refreshed the page repeatedly to see new activity. SSE pushes events
over a persistent HTTP connection without the overhead of WebSockets.
The feed degrades gracefully to polling when EventSource is not available.

good.subject: fix: forward X-Forwarded-For to preserve client IP in access logs
good.description:
Requests routed through the load balancer showed the proxy IP in logs,
breaking geo-IP lookups and rate-limit key derivation. The proxy now
appends the original IP and the app reads it with a trusted-proxy allowlist.

good.subject: restore: add one-click restore from the most recent 7 daily backups
good.description:
Operators previously had to SSH into the backup host and run a manual
shell script to restore. The new UI lists the last 7 snapshots, shows
size and timestamp, and triggers a restore job with a single button click.

good.subject: fix: fall back to initials when Gravatar returns 404
good.description:
Accounts without a Gravatar showed a broken-image icon in the sidebar.
The avatar component now renders a coloured circle with the user's initials
when the Gravatar request returns a non-2xx status.

good.subject: reports: generate monthly PDF summary with activity trend charts
good.description:
Finance requested a single-page PDF for board reporting. The generator
uses WeasyPrint to render the same HTML template as the web view, so
charts and tables stay in sync without a separate rendering code path.

good.subject: fix: detect and reject circular dependencies in plugin loader
good.description:
A plugin that imported another plugin caused infinite recursion in the
loader, crashing the process with a RecursionError. DFS cycle detection
now runs before any plugin is initialised and reports the cycle path.

good.subject: errors: unify error response shape across all API handlers
good.description:
Clients had to handle three different error JSON structures depending
on which handler raised the exception. A single ErrorResponse dataclass
is now serialised by a global exception handler for all error types.

good.subject: docs: add Kubernetes manifests and Helm chart usage guide
good.description:
The deployment docs only covered Docker Compose. Added manifests for
Deployment, Service, and HPA resources plus a Helm values reference
so teams can deploy to existing clusters without custom scripting.

good.subject: onboarding: add interactive tutorial for first-time users
good.description:
Activation rate for new signups dropped below the 60% threshold.
A five-step guided tour highlights the three core actions and surfaces
contextual help tooltips; users who complete it activate at 84%.
